ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

In Henry George «вверенный нам господином талант» (vverenny nam gospodinom talant) is 'the talent entrusted to us by the master' of the Gospel parable, lowercase as printed, and his question keeps its printed final period. «Персидский Джелаледин Руми» (Persidskiy Dzheleledin Rumi) is 'Persian Jalal al-Din Rumi'; «служение» (sluzhenie) is 'service' throughout, and «плотский» (plotskiy) in Buka is 'fleshly'.
